title: v5.103.99 shipped: Zone vacancy sweep: per-zone opt-out honoured, pre-arrival fans kept, manual devices swept, real sweeps recorded
summary: Zone vacancy sweep: per-zone opt-out honoured, pre-arrival fans kept, manual devices swept, real sweeps recorded
why: The 7-day sweep audit found the sweep does real work in only ~6% of fires, and that work is a narrow backstop: lights a person switched on in automated rooms. It also found defects: the master Vacancy Auto-Off switch overwrote each zone's opt-out, the sweep turned off fans that pre-arrival had turned on under a minute earlier, vacancy_sweeps_today counted no-ops, and nothing recorded what was swept. Keep it as a narrow backstop, fix those, and add manual devices (off only).
implications: Shipped HVAC-ZONE-SWEEP-PURPOSE-AND-FIXES-1 at v5.103.99; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.103.99.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: If vacancy_sweep rows show lights a person just turned on, or pre-arrival fans still drop
